in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intelligent, Brave, Sun-like
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mayank हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mayank is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Māyanda', meaning 'Intelligent' and 'Brave'. The name is also related to the Sun, signifying leadership and strength.
